capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-result legacy address enrichment
source_note: All 123 sold, addressless Savills/EIG auction 18813 appearances carrying an exact result and postcode district were checked against official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data for the exact price in the 120-day post-auction window. Fifty-five queries had exactly one transaction. This source banks the 43 whose completion was within 60 days and whose property class and tenure were compatible. One unique but incompatible shop-versus-flat result and all zero/multiple/late results remain unchanged. Original EIG records and repeat appearances remain separate and preserved.
